headline: Latin American Markets React to US Midterms and Commodity Drops
summary: Following US midterm election results, Argentine financial assets dropped sharply with country risk exceeding 850 points and equities sinking up to 8% in Wall Street, while Brazil's Ibovespa rose 1% and the oil market plunged over 8%.
why: Emerging market assets are highly sensitive to shifts in US political landscapes, global risk appetite, and sharp fluctuations in benchmark commodities like crude oil.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Crude oil prices dropped significantly, dragging down energy-related equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A surge in global risk appetite following US political shifts boosted regional equity indices like the Ibovespa, while falling oil prices pressured energy stocks and Argentine assets faced heavy sell-offs.
